mathematics.assertion_tested: Five fixed full Einstein-two-complex-scalar static spherical BVP solutions: four convergence/domain/center variants of one nodeless mixed gradient branch and one TF-like mixed branch. Both exact KG gradients, selfconsistent mass/lapse and proper-volume charge retained. Each tested solution has finite-box converged localization, no resolved field node, positive N, ADM mass below mQ, small physical ODE/constraint residuals and independent mass/charge quadrature agreement. The gradient branch locally exceeds the homogeneous chemical cap; C99 is reported with its separate radius convention.
